name: 04_adjust_shirt_hanger
title: Adjusting Shirt and Sorting Laundry
summary: The robot adjusts a white t-shirt on a wire hanger, hangs it on the railing, sorts laundry in the basket below, and returns to check the hanger.
robot: two black robotic arms with parallel grippers and wrist cameras
setting: a high-rise balcony with a railing overlooking tall buildings and a laundry basket on the floor

source.original_prompt: Adjust the white t-shirt on the hanger

segments.instruction: Use the left gripper to pull the left shoulder of the white t-shirt onto the wire hanger while the right gripper holds the top.
Lift the hanger with the neatly positioned t-shirt and hook it onto the top balcony railing, then release it.
Tilt the camera down towards the laundry basket on the balcony floor, leaving the hung t-shirt out of view above.
segments.memory_event: hide: the white t-shirt on the hanger hanging from the railing

segments.instruction: Reach both grippers into the laundry basket and grasp the red garment.
Lift the red garment and turn the camera and arms to the left, placing it down onto the floor area to the side.
segments.memory_event: hide: the laundry basket on the floor

segments.instruction: Turn the camera back down towards the laundry basket, bringing it back into view.
segments.memory_event: return: the laundry basket with remaining white clothing inside

segments.instruction: Tilt the camera up towards the balcony railing where the white t-shirt was hung.
segments.memory_event: return: the white t-shirt properly positioned on the wire hanger hooked onto the balcony railing

segments.instruction: Grasp the hook of the wire hanger with the right gripper and lift it slightly off the railing.
